Repository dependency and workflow checks; not proof of a complete signed provenance/SBOM pipeline.
Application logging/redaction helper; no centralized retention or WORM sink is evidenced.
Repository CI workflow; GitHub repository settings and deployed environment are outside this file.
Release-quality gate; its editorial findings are not security vulnerability counts.
Read-only source for the user's exact 99-control names/order; not integrated.

PROJECT BLACKOUT implementation remains in an open PR; no active application integration or persistent production state was verified.
PR body reports 302 inherited human-review findings blocking release. The release-quality check failed; this is an editorial publication gate, not a technical vulnerability count.
Merged change keeps enforced CSP in production when report-only is requested. The observed release-quality check failed while the security-focused checks passed.

WAF, hardening, monitoring, and recovery artifacts are PR-only templates; no deployed WAF or infrastructure was verified. The observed release-quality checks failed; listed fortress/security/smoke checks passed.

mitre.name: Exploit Public-Facing Application
mitre.gaps: Public web routes are active; no deployed WAF or live production verification is evidenced. This mapping is not a claim that a vulnerability was found.
mitre.remediation: Maintain code-level validation and verify edge controls in the authorized production configuration.

mitre.name: Supply Chain Compromise
mitre.gaps: Repository checks exist; full signed provenance, action pinning, and release attestations are not established by this review.
mitre.remediation: Close build provenance gaps and retain verifiable dependency/build evidence.

mitre.name: Data Manipulation
mitre.gaps: Local integrity checking does not prevent a write-authorized actor from changing both content and its expected manifest.
mitre.remediation: Anchor trusted content manifests outside the same write authority and require reviewed changes.

mitre.name: Network Denial of Service
mitre.gaps: Network/edge mitigation, capacity, and distributed rate limits are not verified; PR #73 is open.
mitre.remediation: Obtain provider evidence and test limits only in an explicitly authorized non-production environment.

mitre.name: Valid Accounts
mitre.gaps: No active application accounts, IdP, or session issuer exists to assess.
mitre.remediation: Reassess if accounts are introduced; require provider-backed MFA and lifecycle controls.

risks.title: Repository protection cannot be verified
risks.riskRationale: The branch-protection API returned 404; the response cannot establish whether rules are absent or the current credential lacks access.
risks.mitigation: Verify rulesets, required review, and status checks with an authorized repository owner.

risks.title: Public availability controls are unverified
risks.riskRationale: No deployed WAF, anti-DDoS, origin restriction, or shared rate-limit evidence is available; exposure and capacity are unknown.
risks.mitigation: Verify provider controls and limits; do not run active traffic tests without explicit authorization.

risks.title: CSP still allows unsafe-inline
risks.riskRationale: The code enforces a restrictive CSP, but inline script allowance weakens XSS containment; existing rendering defenses lower likelihood but do not remove impact.
risks.mitigation: Adopt nonce-compatible CSP and verify behavior on the deployed app.

risks.title: Future privileged features need a real identity boundary
risks.riskRationale: Current admin routes are closed, so the scenario is conditional; enabling future accounts without a provider-backed authorization boundary could expose editorial integrity.
risks.mitigation: Keep routes closed until IdP, server-side authorization, MFA, and audit identity are tested.

risks.title: Future non-public content could be exposed by a public route
risks.riskRationale: The current model is read-oriented and no private data store is evidenced, but production routing/data visibility was not observed and future draft content would change the impact.
risks.mitigation: Keep draft/private data out of public loaders and verify route-level visibility before introducing it.

risks.title: BLACKOUT is not an integrated response capability
risks.riskRationale: The decision engine is in open PR #71 only; there is no integrated durable state or production adapter to rely on during an incident.
risks.mitigation: Do not claim the control is active; review persistence, adapter safety, approval, and recovery before integration.

risks.title: Immutable evidence retention and recovery are unverified
risks.riskRationale: Local hashes and backup utilities help detect errors but do not establish WORM retention, independent custody, or successful production restore.
risks.mitigation: Use separately administered immutable storage and conduct a documented restore/evidence-retention exercise.

risks.title: Development-to-production drift cannot be ruled out
risks.riskRationale: No production deployment or response-header observation was available; source configuration alone cannot prove deployed behavior.
risks.mitigation: Verify configuration and security headers on each authorized deployment.

risks.title: Human-review publication gate remains blocked
risks.riskRationale: PR #71 reports 302 inherited human-review findings blocking release. These are editorial review findings, not 302 security vulnerabilities.
risks.mitigation: Preserve the existing human-review gate and resolve editorial findings through the approved review process.
